verdict.rationale: Docs show creating sessions via API (curl example), tracking status through the verification_sessions API, listening for status-change events/webhooks, and programmatically retrieving verification results and collected images/data (docs-4,5,6,7,13,15,16). However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of cancel or redact endpoints/operations, only related review-tool actions like status override and blocklisting (docs-10,11) which are not the same as cancel/redact. Missing for 10: explicit documented cancel session endpoint, explicit documented redact/delete PII endpoint, and independent confirmation these lifecycle calls work end-to-end.
